If I could change the world in one way, I would prioritize global education and equal opportunities. Ensuring that every individual has access to quality education would empower people to make informed decisions, solve problems, and pursue opportunities that help them reach their full potential. Education can break the cycle of poverty, foster understanding and empathy between cultures, and inspire innovations that address global challenges.

In addition to education, I would work towards equal opportunities by promoting policies and practices that eliminate discrimination based on race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, and economic status. Everyone deserves the same chances to succeed, regardless of their background. By ensuring equal opportunities, we can create a more just and equitable society where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
